meta.notes: Foreword tutorial: map, library sheet, terrain-association grid of the fuel point landmark.

tlog.msg: CHAPTER F.2 — THE MAP IS NOT THE TERRITORY (NORMAL). Training target: a derelict landing craft on the beach, grid bearing ~1600 mils. It cannot shoot back. Neither could the last observer.
MET: wind from 1300 mils at 2 m/s — read your smoke; it will drift downwind. Rounds are not wind-corrected on this net (the FDC applies met).

Your OP: watchtower at grid 245 554, ground elev 262 m, deck +300 m. Use [B] binos and [L] laser to fix the target ([M] map, [K] mission menu), then send your call for fire — grid, polar, or shift from a known point. Hold [SPACE] to transmit by voice, or type below.

NAVIGATION: your heading readout is MAGNETIC. The grid, the map sheet and the fire net are GRID. Declination is 7° EAST, so GRID = MAG + 124 mils. Send OT DIRECTION in GRID — [R] has the conversion on the mil card, and the sheet carries the declination diagram.

Known points registered: AB1001 "DERBY" grid 271 566 (grid brg 1164) · AB1002 "ICEBOX" grid 218 548 (grid brg 4585). Shift example: "adjust fire, shift known point 1001, right 200, add 400, over" — the KP name works too ("shift BREWERY").

NO-STRIKE: civilian villages HIKE and MOVA and FAVANGO — plotted on your map sheet. Collateral damage fails the mission, same as fratricide. Permanent structures and roads are on the sheet too — use them to orient.
>>> THE JOB: Training target: a derelict landing craft on the beach, grid bearing ~1600 mils. It cannot shoot back. Neither could the last observer.
NORTH OF GRAVEYARD, WITHIN TWO THOUSAND METRES OF IT
This net has seen career-enders, mercy kills, and one observer who called fire on his own foxhole by accident. Let us find out which one you are, over.
GUNNY BOTTLECAP: Map up — press [M]. Roads, tracks, villages, facilities: plotted. Enemy: never. Finding HIM is the job.
GUNNY BOTTLECAP: Now the real sheet — press [P] and study the full 1:50,000. Print it if you have a printer; this trade is done on paper. Close it when you have the lay of the island.

MUSTANG 12, HELLHOUND FIRES — BATTALION S-TWO, WHO WERE VERY PLEASED WITH THEMSELVES REPORTS ACTIVITY IN THIS GENERAL AREA — NORTH OF GRAVEYARD, WITHIN TWO THOUSAND METRES OF IT. STATIC. ABANDONED. DEEPLY UNTHREATENING. 15 MINUTES OLD, OVER.
GUNNY BOTTLECAP: Last rep: TERRAIN ASSOCIATION. Find the FUEL PT on your map and send me its six-digit grid — say or type "grid" and the number. Do not lase it. Read the paper.
Net is mid-transmission — your traffic is copied. Stand by.
GUNNY BOTTLECAP: That is terrain association. You found a thing in the world on a piece of paper. Some officers never manage it.
THAT IS ALL THEY GAVE ME. ONE DERELICT LANDING CRAFT, NONE. IT IS SCRAP, AND IT IS YOURS. NOTHING FINER, OVER.
That report has been passed through four radios and two liars. Verify it yourself.
